proposition_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water, except where permitted by specific exceptions.
display_label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
subject: A person
object: organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
evidence_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water, except in so far as doing so is permitted by paragraph (2) or (4).
reason: Core prohibition with clear exceptions cross-referenced to later paragraphs.

proposition_text: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or species-rich semi-natural grassland that is notified as SSSI or subject to agri-environmental commitment, during 1st June to 31st October, not directly on surface water, and not exceeding 12.5 tonnes per hectare annually.
display_label: Exception for livestock manure on designated land
subject: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure)
object: on land managed for breeding wader birds or as a species-rich semi-natural grassland
conditions: land comes within paragraph (3) (notified SSSI or agri-environmental commitment)
spread in the period that begins with 1st June and ends with the following 31st October
not spread directly on to surface water
total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare
evidence_text: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread if— a it is spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or as a species-rich semi-natural grassland and the land comes within paragraph (3), b it is spread in the period that begins with 1st June and ends with the following 31st October, c it is not spread directly on to surface water, and d the total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare.
reason: Exception with four cumulative conditions clearly enumerated in subparagraphs (a)-(d).

proposition_text: Land is designated for the livestock manure exception if it is notified as a site of special scientific interest under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
subject: Land
rule: comes within this paragraph if it is
object: notified as a site of special scientific interest under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981
evidence_text: notified as a site of special scientific interest under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981
reason: First limb of definition for paragraph (3) land designation.

proposition_text: Land is designated for the livestock manure exception if it is subject to an agri-environmental commitment entered into under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013.
subject: Land
rule: comes within this paragraph if it is
object: subject to an agri-environmental commitment entered into under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013
evidence_text: subject to an agri-environmental commitment entered into under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013.
reason: Second limb of definition for paragraph (3) land designation.

proposition_text: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate may be spread except within 6 metres of surface water if the spreading equipment is a trailing hose band spreader, a trailing shoe band spreader, an injector injecting no deeper than 10cm, or a dribble bar applicator.
display_label: Exception for slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate with specified equipment
subject: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate
rule: may be spread, except within 6 metres of surface water
conditions: spreading equipment is a trailing hose band spreader or a trailing shoe band spreader
spreading equipment is an injector which injects the organic manure no deeper than 10cm below the surface of the soil
spreading equipment is a dribble bar applicator
evidence_text: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate (or any combination of those) may be spread, except within 6 metres of surface water, if the spreading equipment used is— a a trailing hose band spreader or a trailing shoe band spreader, b an injector which injects the organic manure no deeper than 10cm below the surface of the soil, or c a dribble bar applicator.
reason: Exception with equipment conditions enumerated in subparagraphs (a)-(c) and a 6-metre buffer.

proposition_text: Anaerobic digestate means the product of anaerobic digestion other than from sewage or material in a landfill.
